Question: Let \(g(x)\) be a polynomial with leading coefficient \(1,\) whose three roots are the reciprocals of the three roots of \(f(x)=x^3+ax^2+bx+c,\) where \(1\lt a\lt b\lt c.\) What is \(g(1)\) in terms of \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c?\)
